meta.title: Toolchain
meta.description: Adds a Toolchain page to Settings between Models and Plugins. Installed npm/pip dependencies are listed with a Delete button per row above a one-tap install grid; all 13 dependency-root folders show their sizes, the four regenerable ones can be emptied. Toolchains are laid out name + version, and any installed through an npm global prefix or inside the dependency root can be deleted here, while OS-provided ones are marked System to protect the running Harness.
